REM-TRUS-4B8D1E01.title: Remediate: Plaintext HTTP Not Redirected to HTTPS
REM-TRUS-4B8D1E01.what_is_wrong: Missing or permissive HTTP security configuration on endpoint 'https:/www.mistay.in/hotels-in-pune'.
REM-TRUS-4B8D1E01.why_it_matters: Without strict transport security (HSTS) and anti-clickjacking headers, users can be tricked into man-in-the-middle attacks or cross-origin data theft. Violates SOC 2 CC6.6 and ISO 27001 Control A.8.20.
REM-TRUS-4B8D1E01.what_needs_to_be_changed: Configure web application server (Nginx, Cloudflare, or Flask middleware) to emit standard security headers.
step_by_step_instructions: 1. In your web server or edge CDN configuration, enable 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload'.
2. Add header 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff'.
3. Add header 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or configure a strict 'Content-Security-Policy'.
4. Ensure all session and authentication cookies specify 'Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax'.
5. Re-run TrustAudit website perimeter scan against the target URL.
required_evidence: HTTP response header dump showing active HSTS, CSP, and Secure cookie attributes.
Clean TrustAudit perimeter scan verification report.
REM-TRUS-4B8D1E01.verification_procedure: Trigger live HTTP header probe using `website_scanner.py`. Verify that security header score exceeds 90/100.
